name: epwinsights-validation
description: Independent validation of EPW Insights' UTCI, SET, MRT, and Climate Morphing implementations against official reference sources and CMIP6 data.

scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:comfort && npm run sync:morphing
scripts.validate:morphing-unit: npm run validate:morphing-synthetic && npm run validate:morphing-analysis-synthetic
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:utci && npm run validate:set && npm run validate:mrt && npm run validate:mrt-c4 && npm run validate:ground-temp && npm run validate:ground-temp-linearization && npm run validate:ground-temp-hr-accuracy && npm run validate:sharp-sensitivity
scripts.validate:everything: npm run validate:all && npm run validate:morphing-unit && npm run validate:morphing
